🧿 WingetWizard v2.4 - AI-Enhanced Package Manager
=========================================================

🚀 Installation Instructions:
1. Extract all files to your desired location (e.g., C:\Program Files\WingetWizard)
2. Run WingetWizard.exe to start the application
3. Configure your AI providers in Settings (optional)

📋 System Requirements:
- Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
- .NET 6.0 Runtime (included in this package)
- Internet connection for package search and AI features
- Windows Package Manager (winget) - usually pre-installed

🔧 Configuration:
- Copy config.json.example to config.json and edit as needed
- Configure AI providers (Anthropic Claude, AWS Bedrock, Perplexity)
- All settings can be configured through the application UI

✨ Key Features:
- 🔍 Professional package search and installation
- 🤖 AI-powered package analysis and recommendations
- 📦 Batch package operations (install, upgrade, uninstall)
- 🎨 Native Windows theme integration (dark/light mode)
- 🔒 Enterprise-grade security with encrypted credential storage

📞 Support:
- Documentation: See docs/ folder in source repository
- Issues: Report on GitHub
- Website: GeekSuave Labs

Built with ❤️ using .NET 6.0, Windows Forms, and cutting-edge AI technology
